message.content: In the California statewide Attorney General race, Rob Bonta's documented record on Palestinian-justice issues centers on his office's September 2026 diversion agreement dismissing felony vandalism and conspiracy charges against five pro-Palestinian Stanford protesters in exchange for one hundred hours of community service and approximately $52,000 in restitution. On recommendation tiers, CAIR Action endorsed him for the general election, and Vote for Peace supported him at the Ally tier in the general. As contrary evidence, the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated mission includes supporting Israel as a democratic and secure Jewish state, endorsed him in the primary, a recommendation its November 2026 page carries forward for advancing candidates. The guide's saved selection identifies Bonta as the strongest candidate in this race based on these observations.
